observation: Same Sun body with the bank markers rebuilt as four engraved V ticks on the centre bar top, and the twenty-four boundary wedges no longer running to the axis. Top: the four ticks read as deliberate radial marks on the bar at the bank boundaries, the stray speckles that the previous hub carried are gone, and the hub edge is a clean circle with no hooks or slivers. The rim is unchanged: forty-eight separate curled flames on an unbroken disc edge, open ground in every valley, blunt rounded tips, all turning the same way, no closed loop, arch, ribbon or handle. Iso: pockets, key recesses, bar and ticks all present and correctly placed. Front: 6.2 mm tall, flat underside, no face over air. Nothing missing, extra, misplaced or interpenetrating.
